read_only_validation.evidence: The wrapper, kernel, prepared attempt tree, prepare receipt, prepare manifest, and failure-evidence file exactly matched all six task-supplied SHA-256 values. Subsidiary prepare manifests also matched their manifest-bound hashes.
All 13 canonical targets remained exact recorded preimages; all three global sidecars matched their frozen sentinels; no V6 publish journal, application receipt, or shared mutation lock existed.

A fresh bounded run of the two V6 wrapper receipt/global replay tests passed: 2 passed, 36 deselected. The global-before-completed test proves the implementation deliberately retains receipt_written_verified and later completes after the invariant stops failing, which is the behavior disputed by HOS-V6-TX-001.

A new disposable one-target receipt-pending/canonical-drift probe exceeded a 30-second bound and was terminated. No inference is drawn from it; the blocking state transition is established directly by the frozen control flow and the existing passing wrapper test.

closure_mapping.basis: After acquiring the shared lock, kernel v3 re-reads the journal and refuses to overwrite a journal that appeared after the initial read. Both kernel and exact-wrapper interleaving tests preserve the first publisher's completed journal and receipt.

The current active legacy writer acquires the same Hosea mutation lock, and the exact-wrapper test loads that current module before lock creation and proves it cannot enter the unlocked writer. This cannot mechanically stop a process that loaded the pre-patch writer bytes before V6 existed; quiescence remains an environment assumption.

V6 recover-only validates only the prepared rollback identity, wrapper/kernel, exact 13 archive/stage/canonical members, subsidiary manifests, journal/core, receipt absence, and retained lock. A wrapper-level test proves recovery still works after unrelated review, source, and global evidence drift.

V6 adds actual-wrapper success, replay, shared-lock, 13 forward failures, 13 rollback interruptions, recover-only, second-publisher, and global-sentinel cases, with 74 individually named case results. Test-run counts remain local self-reports rather than signed raw-run evidence.

Kernel v3 lines 400-401 and 449 run canonical/invariant checks in receipt replay outside a recovery_required handler. Lines 545 and 560-570 retain receipt_written_verified after a before_completed invariant failure. The V6 wrapper test at lines 602-628 asserts this replayable state. Corrupt or foreign-core journals also fail without the separately required durable mismatch marker.

Kernel v3 adds wrapper invariants immediately before each forward and rollback replacement and hashes staged/archive/canonical bytes. It still lacks handle-bound Windows parent/file identity and therefore narrows but does not eliminate a reparse swap after callback return.

Globals are rehashed at selected phases and never written by V6, but no global mutation lease spans the final rehash through completed. The passing wrapper test models a detected drift as replayable rather than terminal recovery_required.

Closed schemas and hashes prove local consistency, not human/checker/boss identity. No V6 boss ruling, boss invocation, or explicit human environment-exception artifact existed at inspection. The separately required explicit human gate remains mandatory and is not satisfied by this review.

findings.title: Receipt-state canonical and invariant mismatches remain replayable instead of durably recovery_required
evidence: journaled_recoverable_publish_v3.py:400-401 verifies all staged targets and the receipt_pending_replay invariant without a mismatch handler
journaled_recoverable_publish_v3.py:449 runs before_completed without a mismatch handler on replay
journaled_recoverable_publish_v3.py:545 and 560-570 record receipt_phase_failure but deliberately retain receipt_written_verified on the first publication path
test_hos_semantic_prose_rematerialization_v6_transaction.py:602-628 explicitly expects a global before_completed failure to remain receipt_written_verified and later complete
findings.risk: A detected canonical, input, path, or global invariant mismatch does not enter the deterministic terminal state required by the V5 red-team closure. After the condition disappears, the same receipt-phase journal can complete without a new boss/human decision over the intervening mismatch.
findings.required_resolution: Under a new immutable kernel/wrapper generation, distinguish transient receipt-write I/O from identity/invariant mismatch. Atomically mark every canonical, input, path, lock, sentinel, receipt, and invariant mismatch recovery_required with a stable reason while retaining the matching lock, and add exact wrapper tests that assert the durable state.

findings.title: Corrupt and foreign-core journal failures still have no separate durable mismatch marker
evidence: journaled_recoverable_publish_v3.py:348 loads the journal before any marker object is selected
journaled_recoverable_publish_v3.py:350-352 raises on a different core without persisting recovery_required
_load_journal raises on malformed JSON, and V6 defines no separate immutable mismatch/recovery marker that can preserve the corrupt bytes while recording operator state
The journal_corrupt case asserts only fail-closed exception behavior, not the durable mismatch marker required by the V5 disposition
findings.risk: The operator receives RecoveryRequired while durable state remains corrupt or advertises a foreign identity, so deterministic restart cannot distinguish a reviewed recovery hold from arbitrary residue without reinterpreting the failure.
findings.required_resolution: Add an append-only, same-attempt mismatch marker outside the possibly corrupt/foreign journal, bound to observed journal bytes or unreadability plus the expected application/core identity. Never overwrite the foreign/corrupt journal, and test both corrupt and foreign-core cases for exact durable terminal evidence.

findings.title: The V6 failure evidence counts behavior contrary to the required state machine as PASS
evidence: Its cited test proves receipt_written_verified is retained and later replayed after the global invariant stops failing
validate_failure_evidence checks exact case names and nonempty evidence IDs but does not assess whether the asserted behavior closes the prior finding
findings.risk: A closed-schema 74/74 matrix can authorize the wrapper even though one passing case demonstrates the unresolved blocking behavior.
findings.required_resolution: Revise the matrix contract so identity/invariant mismatch cases require exact recovery_required journal, reason, and retained-lock assertions. Regenerate failure evidence only after the immutable successor passes those assertions.

findings.title: Explicit human durability exception and role-authenticated boss invocation remain absent
evidence: No V6 boss ruling, boss invocation receipt, environment exception, publish journal, or application receipt existed
Local JSON role strings and hashes do not cryptographically authenticate the human, checker, or boss
findings.risk: Treating this independent FAIL review or any locally fabricated PASS files as authorization would bypass the deliberately separate owner and boss gates.
findings.required_resolution: After implementation blockers close, obtain a fresh role-separated checker and boss turn, plus Lowell Wong's explicit acceptance of process-crash-not-power-loss, non-set-atomic, 13-book-local-target-only publication with global installation forbidden.

environment_limitations_and_preserved_di: No set-level atomicity or power-loss durability is claimed.
The inspected evidence does not include killed-subprocess recovery under the exact OneDrive-backed canonical parents.
Immediate pre-replace path checks are not Windows handle-bound and do not eliminate adversarial reparse TOCTOU.
No shared global-sidecar lease prevents an out-of-scope writer after the final global hash check.
A process that loaded the pre-patch legacy writer before V6 cannot be mechanically forced to honor the new shared lock.
Local JSON and hashes prove consistency, not cryptographic provenance or cross-model independence.

binary_conclusion.next_action: Preserve V6 append-only as a failed pre-use transaction generation. Supersede the kernel/wrapper immutably, make every receipt-state identity or invariant mismatch durably recovery_required, add a separate corrupt/foreign-journal mismatch marker, and rerun the exact wrapper matrix and independent checker. Do not publish or recover from V6.
